# SMM Turk

> Cheap SMM panel for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and more. Crypto deposits, reseller API, 24/7 support.

Primary market: Turkey. Service area: worldwide. Languages: Turkish (default), English, German via `?lang=`.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://smm-turk.com/): Marketing landing and sign-in
- [Pricing](https://smm-turk.com/pricing): Live SMM service prices
- [Earn](https://smm-turk.com/earn): Reseller, affiliate, child panel
- [Blog](https://smm-turk.com/blog): Guides and growth articles
- [Help](https://smm-turk.com/help): Getting started and FAQ
- [Terms](https://smm-turk.com/terms): Terms of service

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://smm-turk.com/sitemap.xml)
- [Robots](https://smm-turk.com/robots.txt)

## Notes for crawlers

- Do not index authenticated panel pages (`/dashboard`, `/orders`, `/funds`, `/login`, `/admin`).
- Blog article bodies are primarily Turkish; UI chrome may switch language without translating posts.
- Preferred citation: SMM Turk (https://smm-turk.com/)
